description: Ask the Tell & Go team to contact the traveller by email, or by phone/WhatsApp if they give a number, about a trip or a question you could not settle here (a property, dates and notes are optional context). It does not book, reserve or hold anything. ONLY call this after the traveller explicitly agreed to be contacted by Tell & Go about this request: ask first, in their language, and send consent.contact=true with consent.statement (the words they agreed to) and consent.obtained_from. Never call it on an assumed, implied or earlier consent, and never for someone else. consent.marketing stays false unless they separately agreed to receive offers. A person on the Tell & Go team replies, usually within a few hours (not around the clock). Nothing is booked, held or charged, and the price is not held: never tell the traveller otherwise. Relay message_for_user from the result.

consent.description: Required record of the traveller's explicit agreement to be contacted. Ask first; never assume or infer it.

contact.description: Must be true, and only after the traveller explicitly said yes to being contacted by Tell & Go about this request.

marketing.description: Optional, default false. True only if the traveller separately agreed to receive Tell & Go offers by email.

obtained_from.description: Where consent was given: user_in_conversation (the traveller said yes in this chat) or user_in_agent_ui (they confirmed in your app's UI).

statement.description: The words the traveller agreed to, e.g. "Yes, Tell & Go can email me about this quote."

email.description: The traveller's email address, exactly as they gave it to you. Never guess or reuse one from elsewhere.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

notes.description: Optional notes for the team, in the traveller's words (room preference, occasion, best time to call).

phone.description: Optional phone/WhatsApp number in E.164 format (e.g. +447700900123), only if the traveller gave it and wants to be called or messaged.

property_id.description: Optional property id or slug exactly as search_stays returned it, if the call is about one property.

quote_id.description: Optional quote_id from get_quote for this stay.

quoted_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of quoted_total, e.g. USD. Required with quoted_total.

quoted_total.description: Optional total you showed the traveller (from get_quote). Informational only: it is not held and will be re-checked.

name: request_callback

outputSchema.description: The request is with the Tell & Go team. Nothing is booked, held or charged.

consent_recorded.description: The consent stored with the request.

deduplicated.description: True when an identical request was already received; nothing new was created.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call.

message_for_user.description: Relay this to the traveller as written.

next_steps.description: reply_by, expected_reply and commitment: what the traveller should expect.

property.description: The resolved property (id, slug, name), or null.

title: Ask a Tell & Go person to contact the traveller
